artifact: PHASE 4B §14-§18 - immutable snapshots, explicit supersession, and what makes a snapshot set unsafe to resolve against
supersessionRule: a snapshot is superseded only when another snapshot explicitly names it in supersedesSnapshotId. There is no latest-looking, highest-version or newest-timestamp guess.

supersededSnapshotIsSkipped.reason: exactly one candidate matches; selected by EXACT_IDENTITY_AFTER_SUPERSESSION

unapprovedSnapshotIsNotSilentlyUsed.reason: the fact exists but only in snapshots with status DRAFT; this evaluation accepts APPROVED

unapprovedSnapshotUsableOnlyByExplicitPo.reason: exactly one candidate matches; selected by EXACT_IDENTITY

unsafeSetBlocksResolutionEntirely.reason: the snapshot set is not safe to resolve against: SELF_SUPERSESSION (snapshot a supersedes itself); SUPERSESSION_CYCLE (supersession cycle: a -> a)
